name: Streamer Manager
summary: 从小房间起步，安排直播、处理打赏并逐步积累粉丝的主播经营模拟游戏。 开发者披露大部分 2D 美术、部分文本、商店文案与 12 种非韩语本地化使用 AI；音效和音乐为程序合成，运行时不生成内容。

aiAreaNotes.ingame: 开发者明确称运行时不生成内容，无在线或实时 AI 功能。
aiAreaNotes.art: 大部分 2D 视觉素材由生成式图像模型制作并人工编辑。
aiAreaNotes.music: 开发者称音乐和音效由自有脚本程序合成，不是 AI 生成。
aiAreaNotes.writing: UI 文案、对白、聊天文本及商店介绍使用 AI 辅助撰写并人工审核。
aiAreaNotes.translation: 12 种非韩语本地化由 AI 翻译并审核。
aiAreaNotes.marketing: 商店胶囊图等宣传视觉属于披露的 AI 制作范围。

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: Pre-generated content. Most 2D artwork was created with generative image models from our own prompts and then edited by hand: character portraits (both the illustrated avatars and the photo-style streamer portraits, none of which depict real people), room backgrounds, on-air scenes and props, equipment and menu icons, the title illustration, the app icon and the store capsules. In-game text (UI copy, dialogue and chat lines) and the store description were written together with an AI assistant and reviewed by the developer, and the 12 non-Korean localizations were produced with AI translation and reviewed. Music and sound effects are not AI-generated; they are synthesized procedurally by our own scripts. The game does not generate any content at runtime and has no online or live AI features.
